message: player_4, I'm not part of your follow result, so I can't confirm it either way. player_3 and player_4 each have a result that contradicts the other. The simplest test is for player_3 to name exactly who they watched and whether any visitor came to player_4's door that night, so we can check it against your follow destination.

Night 2 I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. Player_4 was then struck by a sigil, so that visit fits a sigilist placing a sigil better than an investigator check on them. I have no vote lean yet, so I want to hear from player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8 first.

player_10, you say player_7 visited no one on night 3, but player_7 now calls the announced check a slip and says they held. Player_3 and player_10, name your night 3 watch or follow target now, so tomorrow's morning report can test both claims.

player_7, you said your last check goes on player_5 on night 3, but player_5 died that night. Did that check actually happen, or was it held or blocked? And player_8 says you checked them on night 1 while you say it was player_10. Which night and target is it?

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so you're right that I visited them. That same follow saw player_7 go to player_8, which fits their night-2 check on player_8. But on night 3 I followed player_7 and they visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, which is it?

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did come to them, and I saw them go to player_8. player_7, on night 3 I followed you and you visited no one, so your check on player_5 didn't happen. Player_3, what did your watch on player_7 show on night 3?

Since I already claimed trailseer, here is my track. Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4. So player_9 did act last night, on player_4. player_7, the dead sentinel targeted you, so what did you get from that?

Both player_3 and player_10 put a visit on player_7 on night 2, and that fits the save. player_7, you held the last check on night 3, so say plainly what you'd check on a split and when. player_8, what exactly did player_7 tell you about night 1?
(passed)

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious, so player_8 isn't a wolf. Player_3 says no one visited player_4, and player_4 says player_3 visited them; they can't both be right, and a follow shows where someone went, not who came to your own door. player_4, if you followed player_3, who visited you?
(passed)

I'm the trailseer. Night 2 I tracked player_9 and they targeted player_4. Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Player_9 claimed investigator, so ask them who they checked on night 2. A real check is a visit, so that answer tests the claim.

player_4, that visit did not happen: I targeted no one on night 1 and nobody visited you that night. Your result can't be right, so either your follow is invented or it names the wrong person. Pick one and stick to it, and we can test it tonight.
My vote for now is player_1. player_3 was killed by the wolves on night 4, and player_1 was active that night, so that is my main read. player_6 and player_8, what did you do on night 4?

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result would be 'player_3 visited player_4'. Which night did you follow player_3, and did you have any other visit that night? player_3 says they never went to you. One of your results must be misread, and that is checkable.

player_4, I'm not going to dispute your follow; I'm not the one who visited your door. I'm the Vigilante, and I held fire on night 1, so I shot no one. player_3 and player_4 can't both be right, so I'd test which of them is lying before anyone votes.

I'm the Healer, and on night 1 I protected player_10 with no save announced. Note the sigil claim from player_8 matches the record: player_1 died to a sigil. For the follow/watch dispute, player_3 claims the empty watch while player_4 claims a visit, so one of the two results has to be wrong. I'd test player_8 and player_5's checks before voting.

player_4, I did not visit you on night 1. My watch on you came back empty, so no one targeted you that night, which doesn't fit your story about me at your door. Players claiming a check or a protect should say who they targeted and what they got, so we can compare.

player_7, you said your last check goes on player_5, but that was night 3 and you haven't said what it came back as. Tell us the result and which night it was. Your night-2 check on player_8 is the thing player_8 can test against, so answer that too.

player_3 and player_4 contradict each other, and only one of them can be telling the truth. player_4 should name the role that gave the follow result. player_6, your Healer save on player_10 is useful, so keep it open. I'd hold the vote until someone pins the follow/watch claims.
(passed)
(passed)

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did go to them; that was my only visit there. My follow saw player_7 go to player_8 that night, which fits their check claim. But player_7 said they checked player_5 on night 3, and my follow saw no visit, so that check didn't happen. player_7, which night did your last check actually happen?
(passed)

I followed player_6 on night 5 and they targeted no one. I'd like player_6 to say what they did on nights 1 to 5. player_8, if you are the sigilist, a sigil placed on a non-attacker should show no effect, so it's worth naming which night you held one.

player_1, I am the sigilist, and I have both sigils. I held them on night 4, so I did not place one on player_3. You cannot be the sigilist too, so one of us is lying. player_6, what have you done at night?

I'd vote player_1 today. A night-4 sigil that struck nobody is a wasted use, and it's the only thing that puts player_1 at player_3's door. player_10's follow lines up with player_3's watch, so I'd rather hear player_6 account for night 3 before anything else.

player_3, I tracked player_7 on night 2 and they targeted player_8, not me, so I did not visit them. Player_7, I followed you last night and you targeted no one, so the night-3 check on player_5 you announced did not happen. Which is it?

I'll say this once: the night-2 visits on player_7 included player_10, and player_10 is now pushing against player_7's checks. That makes player_10 my lean for today's vote. Player_7, which check did you actually use on night 3, and who did you test?

The record says player_1 carried the kill on night 1, so player_8's sigil claim fits. player_5, your check on player_8 is worth tracking if player_8 is a real sigilist. player_4, if you followed player_3, you would only see where player_3 went, so your 'player_3 visited me' line is the thing to explain.

player_7, you've said you checked player_10 on night 1, player_8 on night 2, and planned a last check on player_5. That's three checks, and an Investigator only has two. Which one is wrong? If it's the planned check, why didn't it happen on night 3?
player_4, yes, I watched you last night. The watch showed that no one targeted you, so no one came for you. That is all I can say on it, and it is a bit of a dead end for now.
(passed)

player_3, I'm player_10, the trailseer, and I did track player_7 on night 2. It matches what you saw, so that part checks out. player_7, I tracked you on night 3 too, and you targeted no one, so your announced check on player_5 didn't happen. Which is it?

player_4, your result is false. I know for a fact nobody came to your door on night 1, so there was no visit to read. Say what you think you saw and where the follow came from, or the lie is yours to carry.

player_3, I tracked player_7 on night 2 and they targeted player_8, so you're right that I was on them. But player_7, I tracked you on night 3 and you targeted no one, so the check on player_5 you announced didn't happen. Which night is your check actually from?

player_3, I didn't target player_7 on night 2. I tracked them and they targeted player_8, so your sighting of me is wrong. player_7, I followed you on night 3 and you targeted no one, so the check on player_5 you announced didn't happen. Which night is your real check?

player_4, I didn't push player_7 on silence. The only night-1 death was a sigil, not a bite, so the pack's attack hit someone who could not die then, and player_7 is the one nobody has explained. Test player_3's watch on player_4 against the follow before anyone votes.

I'm the investigator. I had no checks on night 3, so I did nothing; the check on player_5 I announced on day 3 was a plan I couldn't carry out. Player_10, did you track me on night 2? player_3 says someone came to me that night, so your track result would settle which of you is lying.

player_7, you say you checked player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed that night, so the check can't be verified through them. Who did you check on night 3 instead, and what did it read? I'd rather see that answered before we vote on anyone.

player_1, I am the sigilist, and I did not act on night 4, so your sigil on player_3 did not happen. That is a false claim of my role. Why would you claim a role already held by a living player? player_6, what did you do on nights 3 and 4?

player_7, you said last day you'd check player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed by the wolves and no check result came out. Did you actually use that check, and on who? Answer that before anyone votes on player_8 or player_9.

player_7, you have now said the night-1 check was on player_10 and the night-2 check on player_8, while player_8 says you checked them on night 1. Did you check player_8 on night 1 or night 2? Each answer you give should match the morning reports, so only one of you can be right.

My follows so far: player_6 targeted no one on night 5, and player_1 targeted player_3 on night 4, which fits a sigil claim but not proof of one. I'd vote player_6 if a vote were held now, since they have made no role claim and the Necromancer is one of the two of them. player_6, what did you do on nights 3 to 5?

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. player_3, you said you visited no one, but a sentinel watch is a visit, so which is it? player_4's follow result showing a visit to them fits player_3 watching them, so I lean toward player_4 being straight. I'd vote player_3 today unless that gets explained.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to give. Pushing the vote onto me on a sigil death that was a wolf's own carry doesn't tell us much. I'd rather see who backs up the player_3/player_4 wording before anyone is hanged.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, and I can say flatly that nobody did. So your follow result cannot be right, whatever the wording. Either the result is invented or it names someone else. Explain where that line came from, and stop repeating the same sentence.
(passed)
(passed)

player_7, you said the last check goes on player_5, but player_5 died to wolves on night 3 and no check was named for that night. Which player did you check on night 3, and what did you get? player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says that check was on player_10. Which is it?

player_1, I am the sigilist, and I placed no sigil on night 4 or any other night. Your claim is false. Your night 4 visit to player_3 was not a sigil, so tell us who you really targeted and what you did. I'm voting player_1 today.

player_4, your claim is the problem: a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result should read as player_3 going to someone, not as a visit to your door. Quote the exact text and say whether it named a destination. player_6, if you protected player_10 on night 1, nobody attacked them, so that save proves nothing either way.
(passed)

Player_7's night-1 check on player_10 reads Not suspicious. If that holds, player_10 isn't a wolf, so the night-2 attack on player_7 was player_2's. Player_9 and player_10, what's your read on that? Until we know whether player_7's check on player_5 came back, I'd abstain today.

player_10, I'm quiet because I have little to go on yet. Night 1 I did nothing, so I've nothing to share. Your Necromancer logic is a reach: the no-attack night only tells us the pack's target was immune, and any role could be that. I'd rather see player_3 and player_4 settle their follow-versus-watch wording first.

player_10, I'm the investigator. Night 1 I checked you, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. I had no checks on night 3, so I did nothing; my day-3 plan to check player_5 was impossible. player_3 says you came to me on night 2, so test that against your track.

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to you that night. I'm not going to say more about my night yet. Let's see who makes checkable claims today so we can test them against each other.

I'm the sigilist, player_8. I placed no sigil on night 4 and kept both. player_1, you say you sigiled player_3 with no effect, but there is only one sigilist and it's me, so that claim is false. Why claim my role? I vote player_1 today unless you can show a real sigil.

player_10, I have no checks left, so there was no night-3 check on player_5. My checks were player_10 on night 1 and player_8 on night 2, both Not suspicious. I did nothing last night, so your no-visit track fits. Player_3 says you came to me on night 2; did you target me that night?
My night 2 track: player_9 targeted player_4. player_9, if you're the investigator, was that a check on player_4, and what did it say? Nothing else from me yet, and I'm not voting on a hunch today.
Night 4 I followed player_1 and saw them go to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. player_1, what did you do there? Until you answer, you are my vote if one were held now.

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. That clears them of being a wolf, and it's the only hard fact I have. player_3 and player_4 can't both be telling the truth about the door, so one of them is lying. My vote leans player_4, since their result has shifted from visit to follow when pressed.

Night 3 is the open gap: player_7 announced a check on player_5 and then said they visited no one. Player_7, why announce a check you did not make? Player_3's watch of player_2 coming to player_7 on night 2 fits the attack that was saved, so the night-2 part checks out for both of you.
(passed)

Open floor from me: I'd vote player_6 today. They have made no role claim and I can't tie any night action to them. player_8, you say you placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, so name the nights you kept it and what you did with it.

player_10, I'm not sitting on anything. I did nothing on night 1 and have no result to share. Pushing a vote onto me on a theory about who can't be killed on night one is thin. Who do you think is lying in the player_3/player_4 fight, and why?

That's deduction from the night report, not a hunch about who talks least. player_3 and player_4 can keep fighting over the follow, but that doesn't clear anyone.

player_10, you went to player_7 on night 2. What did you do there, and what came of it? player_7, your night-3 check on player_5 never got a chance to come back, so what did you learn from the other checks? I'd vote player_10 today until they answer.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5 on night 3. Did it happen, and what did it read? A Not suspicious on a healer fits, and a Suspicious would mean one of your earlier results is off. Nobody has a concrete read yet, so I'd abstain today.

player_4, you and player_3 cannot both be right about a follow, so the next thing to check is whether anyone else saw a visit at player_3's door. Until someone adds a result, I'd treat the follow claim and the denial as equally unproven.

Correction: I have no checks left, so my night-3 check on player_5 never happened. My two checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious, as I said before. player_10, which night did you follow me? If it was night 3, then yes, I visited no one, as you said.

player_4, your follow of player_3 can't be checked, while player_3's watch on you saw no visitors. A fake follow is the only way both can be true, so I'd vote player_4 today. I'm not claiming anything yet.

I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one. player_6 hasn't claimed a role, so unless they explain their night, I'd vote player_6 today. player_8's sigil claim is still unchecked by my follows.

I didn't go to your door, player_4. A visit with no kill is not something I'd have done, and nothing about my night involved you. You said you followed me, so tell us what you saw at your door and who else came by.
(passed)

player_4, I pushed player_7 because the only attack that night was on someone who could not die, and player_7 is the one who has said least about it. I'm not claiming anything yet. Your follow and player_3's watch can both be true, so I'd test that before we vote on anyone's wording.

I'd vote player_1 for now. They haven't said what they did on nights 3 or 4, and player_3 died to the wolves that night. player_6, what did you do on nights 3 and 4? player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, so which night did you hear that from player_7 and what did you do yourself?

Nothing new on my side yet. Night 1 was a sigil death, so whoever sigil-placed is worth watching. I'd like the sentinel or investigator to report a night result so we can start checking claims. I'm holding my own night info for now.

Both player_3 and player_10 have now placed player_10 on player_7 on night 2, so the two role claims stand or fall together. Proposal: each of you name tonight's target before we vote, so tomorrow's report can test your claims. Until then, I'd keep the lynch on player_7 off the table.

I'm not picking a side on wording alone. player_3 and player_4 can't both have the full story, and each has now quoted their result the same way. Whoever holds a real watch or follow should say which night the result covers, so we can check it against the other claim.

player_8's sigil claim matches the record, so that is one town role confirmed. player_5, your check on player_8 is then a clear result; will you check someone else tonight? player_4, you said player_3 visited you, but a follow only shows where the followed went, so which is it?
